description: Validate a national identity, tax or company registration number against its country's official checksum rule. Covers 23 countries including NL BSN, ES NIF/NIE/CIF, IT codice fiscale, FR SIREN/SIRET, DE Steuer-ID, BE/PL/CZ national numbers, SE/NO/DK/FI personal numbers, BR CPF/CNPJ, AU ABN/TFN, UK NINo, IE PPS, US NPI/EIN. Structure and check digit only — no registry lookup; the number itself is never stored (logs keep only its length and character types). Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, case-insensitive. One of the 23 supported countries; the United Kingdom is accepted as UK or GB (the response echoes what you sent). Accepted: one of the 23 supported ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

kind.description: Identifier type for that country, e.g. bsn, nif, cf, cpf. Accepted: an identifier kind supported for the country.

value.description: The identifier. Separators (space . - /) are stripped before checking. Accepted: at most 64 characters.

name: id_national
title: National identity- and company-number validation, 23 countries
